Container.Name: my-meal-plan
Container.Overview:
My Meal Plan - a simple, self-hosted planner for your family's dinners from Sunday to Saturday.
Reusable meal presets with photos, drag-and-drop swapping that works on phones, separate schedules for every week, Copy Last Week, Clear Week and random meals.
Home Assistant integration: every day at your reminder time the server POSTs tonight's dinner to a Home Assistant webhook so you get a "Dinner Tonight" notification on your phone. Configure the webhook URL, reminder time and timezone in the app under Settings.
All data (SQLite database + meal photos) is stored in the Data path.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: SQLite database (meal-plan.db) and uploaded meal photos (uploads/). Back this folder up.

Config.Name: Timezone (first start)
Config.Description: Timezone used for 'today' and the dinner reminder on first start. Change it later in the app under Settings.

Config.Name: App URL (optional)
Config.Description: The address you open the app with, e.g. http://192.168.1.20:3000. When set, Home Assistant webhooks include an image_url so notifications can show the meal photo.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID that owns the files in the Data path (99 = nobody on Unraid).

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID that owns the files in the Data path (100 = users on Unraid).
